summary.headline: A chart with two classical strengths, Venus exalted in the career house and Jupiter in its own sign in the partnership house, now running a six-year Sun period that rewards steady, self-directed effort; the clearest window for commitment and for formal partnerships is the Jupiter sub-period from mid-2028.

key_points.text: Your professional standing is the chart's strongest theme: exalted Venus in the 10th house forms Malavya yoga, a classical sign of skill and recognition in creative work.
Marriage is well supported (the 7th lord Jupiter sits in its own sign in the 7th); the main window is the Jupiter sub-period, May 2028 to March 2029.

Starting your own studio is better prepared through 2027 and launched once Saturn settles in your 11th house of gains, from February 2028; Saturn returns to the 11th for a second, shorter stretch from late 2029.
Savings need deliberate structure: the 2nd house of savings scores low in Ashtakavarga and its lord, the Moon, is debilitated (with cancellation) in the 6th.
The current Moon sub-period, to February 2027, puts work load and routines in the foreground; rest and pacing matter more than usual.

lagna.text: Gemini rises, with Jupiter's aspect on the 1st house. Gemini lagna describes a quick, curious, verbal mind that learns by connecting ideas. Its lord Mercury sits in the 8th house in Capricorn: you go deep rather than broad, are drawn to research and hidden structure, and do your best thinking in private before you present it.

moon.text: The Moon is in Scorpio in the nakshatra Jyeshtha, in the 6th house. Scorpio is the Moon's sign of debilitation, which describes feelings that run deep and are not shown easily, and a mind that settles through work and problem-solving. Two classical cancellation clauses hold: the lord of Scorpio (Mars) is in an angle from the Moon, and the lord of the Moon's exaltation sign (Venus) is in an angle from the lagna (the 10th house), so the weakness is described as one that is overcome with effort.

sun.text: The Sun is in Aquarius in the 9th house, together with Saturn in its own sign and Mars. Your sense of purpose is tied to principles, teachers and a broad view of life; Saturn with the Sun asks for patience with authority figures and describes respect that is earned slowly.

current_period.text: Since May 2026 you are in the Sun major period, which runs to May 2032. The Sun rules your 3rd house of initiative and skills and sits in the 9th of principles and mentors, so the six years favour self-directed effort, learning from seniors and building a reputation of your own. Within it, the Moon sub-period (to February 2027) brings the 6th-house themes of work load and routines forward; the Mars sub-period (February to June 2027) adds drive; the Rahu sub-period (June 2027 to May 2028) brings change and new settings; the Jupiter sub-period (May 2028 to March 2029) is the strongest stretch for partnership.

yogas.text: Three classical yogas stand out. Hamsa (Jupiter in its own sign in an angle) and Malavya (Venus exalted in an angle) are two of the five 'great person' yogas and describe wisdom in partnerships and refinement in work. Lakshmi yoga (the 9th lord and Venus each strong in an angle or trine) supports fortune through your own merit. One Raja-yoga reading of Venus is disputed between the sources and is not relied on.

strengths.text: Every planet meets its classical minimum strength (Shadbala ratio above 1), with Venus the strongest. In Ashtakavarga the 6th (38 points) and 4th (36) houses are best supported, so work under pressure and your home base are reliable; the 9th (19), 8th (22) and 2nd (23) are the weakest, so luck through others and savings need conscious effort.

transits.text: Saturn now moves through Pisces, your 10th house, which asks for responsibility and patience at work; Jupiter is in Leo, the 3rd house of skills and communication. Rahu leaves your 9th house for the 8th in December 2026. Sade Sati is not active.

overview.text: In the Lal Kitab chart three planets (Sun, Mars and Saturn) share house 9 and form artificial planets there, so the house of fortune and elders is crowded and active. Rahu in house 4 is in the 'dharmi' state, which the book reads as a calmer, protective Rahu. The Moon, Mars and Mercury sit in placements the book calls 'sinful' (the book's term for a placement it reads as less helpful; not a judgement of you). Most planets are 'asleep' by the Shrimali test because the houses they look at are empty; the 1952 edition agrees for the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury and Saturn and gives no sleeping test for Jupiter, Venus and Ketu. The editions also disagree on the Moon in house 6: Shrimali says remedies do not change it, the 1952 edition treats it as remediable.

debts.text: Three debt signatures appear in both editions under different names: one for relatives (Mars, with Mercury in house 8), one for sisters and daughters (Mercury, with the Moon in house 6) and one the 1952 edition calls 'dargahi' (Ketu, with the Moon in house 6). The 1952 edition judges a debt across the family's charts, so these are patterns to be aware of, not declared debts.

varshaphal.text: In this annual chart (February 2026 to February 2027) Jupiter moves into house 1 and the Moon into house 4, which the book reads as a supported year for the person and the home; Venus moves into house 6, so care with health routines and with workplace relationships is advised.

indicators.text: Jupiter, lord of the 7th house of marriage, sits in its own sign in the 7th: the classical picture of a committed, principled partnership and a partner who is educated or a guide.
Venus is exalted in the birth chart and in its own sign in the navamsa (D9), so affection and harmony are well supported at both levels of the chart.
The upapada (the Jaimini point for marriage) falls in Capricorn, whose lord Saturn is strong in its own sign: commitment is taken seriously and tends to be lasting.

current_period.text: The Sun period is about your own direction; relationships are not its main theme until the Jupiter sub-period from May 2028, when the 7th-house lord itself is activated.

windows.label: Jupiter sub-period (main window)
windows.text: The lord of the 7th house runs the sub-period.

cautions.text: Rahu enters your 7th house in June 2028, at the same time as the Jupiter window: keep expectations explicit and decisions unhurried.

Of the four Kuja conventions checked, Mars meets only one. The popular rule (as reported in Light on Life) is met, counting from the Moon and from Venus; the classical rule (BPHS 80.47-49) is not met; the Phaladeepika rule (XI.3, Mars in the 7th) is not met; and the HJH2 rule is not met, because its own source exempts Mars in Aquarius. Kuja is a convention, not a verdict on any relationship.

indicators.text: Exalted Venus in the 10th house (Malavya and Amala yogas) points to recognition through design, aesthetics and refined work: architecture fits the chart well.
The 10th lord Jupiter sits in the 7th house of partners and clients: work grows through collaborations and client relationships more than through solitary employment.
In the career chart (D10) Venus is again in Pisces, its sign of exaltation, which repeats the professional promise.

current_period.text: The Sun major period, with the Sun ruling the 3rd house of initiative, favours taking charge of your own work; Saturn's transit of your 10th house asks you to build the foundation carefully first.

windows.label: Saturn's first pass through your 11th house
windows.text: A preview: networks and first clients.

windows.label: Saturn in the 11th house (launch window)
windows.text: Steady gains from your own effort.

windows.label: Saturn back in your 11th house
windows.text: A second, shorter stretch of gains from long-term effort.

cautions.text: Ketu shares the 10th house with Venus: periods of doubt about your direction are part of the pattern; decide on evidence (clients, cash flow), not on mood.
The Rahu sub-period (June 2027 to May 2028) brings restlessness and unusual offers; check the terms of any partnership in writing.

indicators.text: The 2nd house of savings is the third-weakest in Ashtakavarga (23 points) and its lord, the Moon, is debilitated (with cancellation) in the 6th: income tends to go into work and obligations unless savings are automatic.
Lakshmi yoga and an 11th house of gains with 30 points describe income that rises with your own standing.

current_period.text: The Moon sub-period, to February 2027, activates the 2nd-house lord in the 6th: expect expenses linked to work and routines.

windows.label: Jupiter in your 2nd house
windows.text: A good stretch to set up savings and increase fees.

cautions.text: Rahu moves through your 8th house from December 2026: avoid speculative or opaque financial arrangements in that stretch.

indicators.text: The 12th lord Venus is exalted in the 10th: foreign connections tend to come through work (clients, projects or a posting) rather than as a goal in themselves.
Rahu in the 4th house describes a home base that changes or a pull away from the place you grew up.

current_period.text: The Rahu sub-period from June 2027 is the part of the Sun period most open to travel and new settings.

windows.label: Rahu sub-period
windows.text: Travel, study trips or work abroad.

windows.label: Saturn enters your 12th house
windows.text: A first touch of the 12th house: longer stays abroad become possible.

cautions.text: The 9th house of long journeys is the weakest in Ashtakavarga (19 points): plan travel well and keep backups.

indicators.text: Mercury, your lagna lord, in the 8th house favours deep, research-type learning; Rahu in the 4th adds interest in technology and unconventional subjects.
The 5th lord Venus is exalted: creative and design skills come easily and can be trained to a high level.

current_period.text: The Sun period, through its rulership of the 3rd house of skills, supports short courses and certifications that build your own practice.

windows.label: Jupiter in your 4th house
windows.text: Good for formal study or a professional qualification.

cautions.text: With Mercury in the 8th, learning is thorough but slow to show: give new skills a full year before judging them.

indicators.text: The 4th house of home is well supported in Ashtakavarga (36 points), although Rahu there brings changes of residence.
The 5th house is ruled by exalted Venus, and Jupiter, the natural significator of children, is strong in its own sign; the chart shows warm family themes.
The Sun with Saturn in the 9th describes a respectful but sometimes formal relationship with your father or elders.

current_period.text: The Sun period, the Sun being the natural significator of the father, brings your father or other elders into focus over these years.

family.no_window_reason: This report does not give timing for children or family additions; that is a personal and medical matter. Home-related timing appears in the education and wealth chapters.

cautions.text: Rahu in the 4th can make the home feel unsettled during moves; keep a stable routine at home.

indicators.text: The 6th house, which shows how you deal with illness and stress, is the best supported in Ashtakavarga (38 points): resilience and recovery are strengths.
The Moon, which describes the mind and rest, sits in the 6th: stress shows first in sleep and routine, so rest is your main wellness lever.

current_period.text: The Moon sub-period, to February 2027, puts routine and work load in focus; protect sleep and regular meals.

windows.label: Mars sub-period: pace yourself
windows.text: High energy: good for exercise; pace yourself and rest between efforts.

cautions.text: Mercury, the lagna lord, in the 8th suggests that worry turns inward; talk things through rather than carrying them alone, and see a doctor for any physical concern.

indicators.text: The 9th house holds the Sun, Mars and Saturn in its own sign: a disciplined, practical path (regular practice, service, study of principles) suits you better than devotion to a person.
Ketu in the 10th asks that work itself become a form of practice: craft done well as service.

current_period.text: The Sun period, with the Sun in the 9th house of dharma, is a good time to establish a regular practice.

cautions.text: Saturn with the Sun can turn discipline into rigidity; keep practice simple and kind to yourself.

answers.answer: The chart supports marriage well: the lord of the 7th house, Jupiter, sits in its own sign in the 7th, and Venus is strong in both the birth chart and the navamsa. The clearest window is the Jupiter sub-period of your Sun period, when the 7th lord itself is active; a later transit window comes when Jupiter returns to your 7th house in 2031.
answers.short: Best window: the Jupiter sub-period (May 2028 – March 2029); a later window in 2031.

evidence.text: 7th lord Jupiter in its own sign in the 7th house
Venus exalted, and in its own sign in the navamsa
Kuja: 1 of 4 conventions met (popular rule, per Light on Life); BPHS 80.47-49 and Phaladeepika XI.3 not met; HJH2 rule not met, exempted for Mars in Aquarius

answers.what_to_do: Be open to introductions from 2028; use 2027 to get clear on what you want in a partner. Only one of the four Kuja conventions, the popular rule, is met here (the BPHS and Phaladeepika rules are not, and HJH2 exempts Mars in Aquarius), so treat it as a convention, not a reason to delay.

answers.answer: The chart supports it, with a sequence: prepare through 2027 and launch from February 2028. Your career promise is strong (exalted Venus in the 10th, its lord Jupiter in the house of partners), and the first months of Saturn in your 11th house (June to October 2027) are a good trial run for your own clients. The firmer window is the launch window from February 2028, when Saturn settles in the 11th and the Jupiter sub-period favours partnerships; Saturn comes back to the 11th for a shorter second stretch from late 2029. This is guidance, not financial advice; check the business plan and finances with a qualified adviser.
answers.short: The chart supports it: prepare in 2027, launch from February 2028.

10th lord Jupiter in the 7th house of partners and clients

answers.what_to_do: Build a client list and savings buffer through 2027; formalise any partnership in writing during the Rahu sub-period; plan the launch for spring 2028, after checking the business plan and finances with a qualified adviser (this is guidance, not financial advice).

answers.answer: Your chart shows good resilience (the 6th house scores 38 points, the highest), with stress showing first in sleep and routine because the Moon sits in the 6th. The Moon sub-period to February 2027 and the energetic Mars sub-period after it are when pacing matters most. This is general wellness guidance, not medical advice.
answers.short: Resilient overall; protect sleep and pacing, especially to mid-2027.
answers.what_to_do: Keep a fixed sleep time and regular meals; plan exercise in the Mars sub-period; see a doctor for any physical symptom.

answers.answer: The 5th house of children is ruled by exalted Venus and Jupiter, the natural significator of children, is strong in its own sign, which the tradition reads as a warm and supportive picture for family life. This report does not time children or comment on fertility; those are personal and medical matters.
answers.short: A supportive picture; no timing is given.

answers.no_window_reason: Timing for children is not given in these reports; please consult a doctor for any personal question about it.
answers.what_to_do: Treat this as background only; personal decisions about a family are yours and your partner's.

answers.answer: A disciplined, regular practice suits you better than an intense devotional one: the 9th house holds the Sun and Mars with Saturn in its own sign. Short daily practice (meditation, chanting or study in your own tradition) and service through your work (Ketu in the 10th) fit the chart. The Ketu sub-period (December 2030 to May 2031) is a naturally reflective stretch.
answers.short: A short, regular daily practice and service through work.

evidence.text: Sun, Mars and own-sign Saturn in the 9th house

answers.what_to_do: Start with ten minutes a day at a fixed time; review after three months.

vedic.title: Thursday practice for Jupiter
vedic.instructions: On Thursdays, ten minutes of prayer or study in your own tradition, and a small act of help to a teacher or student. Continue for a few months; stop whenever you wish.

why.text: Jupiter rules your 7th and 10th houses (partnership and career), the two areas you asked about most.

vedic.title: Monday rest and routine for the Moon
vedic.instructions: Keep Monday evenings light: regular sleep, a short walk, time with your mother or an elder. Traditional Monday chanting of your own tradition is optional.

why.text: The Moon, lord of your 2nd house, is debilitated in the 6th house of work load.

lal_kitab.remedy: Help your father drink water from your hands (the book's wording); in practice, serve your father and elders
lal_kitab.instructions: Regularly help your father or another elder in small, practical ways; the book's process is 43 days unbroken, in daylight, done by you. Optional.
lal_kitab.dispute: Shrimali's edition says this placement is not changed by remedies; the 1952 edition treats it as remediable. Shown as an optional practice only.

lal_kitab.remedy: The book says 'Jupiter remedies' without detail; a modern low-risk way to honour Jupiter is to support students and teachers (not the book's wording).
lal_kitab.instructions: Once a week, help a student or a teacher in a small, practical way. Optional; one remedy at a time.
